_doc: Random events (docs/design/CAMPAIGN.md §6). Each choice: requires, cost, risk tag, weighted outcomes of effect ops (docs/CAMPAIGN_SYSTEMS.md#events). 'group' events are decided once for the whole co-op party.

items.title: Free Sample
items.speaker: Needles
items.text: Needles leans out of a van. "New batch. Totally legal. Probably."

choices.label: Take it
choices.desc: A random Prescription supplement and a random side effect.

outcomes.text: It fizzes. You feel... something.
"You never saw me." He presses Scrip into your paw.

items.title: The Weigh-In
items.speaker: Commission clerk
items.text: The Commission wants you on the scale. The scale is broken.

choices.label: Cut weight
choices.desc: Max HP -8, walk speed +0.2 m/s this run.

outcomes.text: You sweat it out in a sauna that is also a shipping container.

choices.label: Bulk up
choices.desc: Max HP +12, dash -0.3 m this run.

outcomes.text: Four buckets of chum later, you tip the scale. It was already tipped.
The scale reads exactly what you paid it to read.

items.title: Sponsor Read
items.speaker: Producer
items.text: A producer hands you a card. "Say it with feeling."

choices.label: Read it
choices.desc: +50 Scrip; your Hype carry drops to 0 (you're embarrassed).

outcomes.text: "Glandco JUICE: it's in you now." You will never forgive yourself.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.desc: Next fight you start with +30 Hype (the crowd respects it).

outcomes.text: The crowd chants your name. The producer chants something else.

items.title: Dock Dice
items.speaker: Dockworkers
items.text: Dockworkers roll bones on an upturned crate.

choices.label: Bet 30 Scrip
choices.desc: 45% win 70 Scrip, 40% lose the stake, 15% loaded dice: win 70 and a crate charm.

outcomes.text: Snake eyes. Yours.
The bones betray you.
These dice are loaded. In your favor. Nobody says a word.
You keep your Scrip and your dignity. Mostly the Scrip.

items.title: Lost Dog
items.text: A huge, sad, sludge-soaked hound is tied to a bollard. He looks hungry.

choices.label: Feed him
choices.desc: Lose 10 HP (he bites). Bilge starts the boss fight at 90% HP and skips his first Lunge-Chomp.

outcomes.text: He takes the food. And a bit of you. Good boy.
He's thrilled. You're covered in sludge. Worth it.
He watches you go. Very sadly.

items.title: Commission Hearing
items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: A notice: you are summoned for "conduct." Snappington isn't there. A clerk is.

outcomes.text: The clerk stamps something. Loudly.
"Evidence," says the clerk, pocketing it.
Case dismissed. The clerk looks disappointed.
Contempt of Commission. Pay up AND hand it over.

items.title: Cut-Woman
items.speaker: Doc Sutura
items.text: Doc Sutura flags you down between bouts, eight hands already moving.

outcomes.text: "Hold still. Hold stiller."
"You'll live. That's a medical opinion and a threat."
She shrugs all eight shoulders.

items.title: Vending Machine
items.text: A Glandco machine hums. The glass is cracked.

outcomes.text: Clunk.

choices.label: Kick it
choices.desc: 50% free Over-the-Counter supplement, 50% it falls on you (-15 HP).

outcomes.text: Something drops out. Free!
The machine falls on you. The machine is fine.
Clunk. Clunk. Pharmacy clunk.

items.title: The Bookie
items.speaker: Teddy Two-Tooth
items.text: Teddy Two-Tooth: "Odds on your next fight are... unflattering."

choices.label: Bet on yourself (40 Scrip)
choices.desc: Win the next fight without being knocked down: 120 Scrip.

outcomes.text: "A sentimental bet. I love it."

effects.text: Bet placed: no knockdowns next fight

choices.label: Bet against yourself
choices.desc: Free. If you get knocked down next fight: +50 Scrip.

outcomes.text: "The announcer will notice. He always notices."
"Your loss. Literally, probably."

items.title: Press Conference
items.text: Microphones. Cameras. Someone from Glandco mouthing "say the name".

choices.label: Trash talk
choices.desc: Next fight both sides start at 40 Hype.

outcomes.text: You say something unprintable. They print it.

effects.text: Next fight: everyone starts at 40 Hype

outcomes.text: "I just want to thank the Commission." Somewhere, a turtle smiles.
"Glandco JUICE." Cha-ching.

items.title: Scrap Crane
items.speaker: Ludlow
items.text: A crane dangles a crate over the pit. Ludlow shrugs: "Could be anything."

choices.label: Grab it
choices.desc: Fight 3 Scraplings while the crane hook swings. Win: a Treasure pick.

outcomes.text: Three Scraplings think it's theirs.
Ludlow watches the crate sway. "Huh."

items.title: Sparring Offer
items.speaker: Kid Lamprey
items.text: Kid Lamprey, hood up: "Three rounds. Lose and I tell everyone."

choices.label: Spar
choices.desc: Fight a copy of yourself at 60% HP. No HP lost either way. Win: a technique pick.

outcomes.text: He puts on a wig that looks like you.
"Scared. Noted. Telling everyone."

items.title: A Crate of JUICE
items.text: Unmarked. Still cold. Nobody is watching.

choices.label: Drink one
choices.desc: Max HP +10 and a random side effect.

outcomes.text: It glows on the way down.

choices.label: Drink three
choices.desc: Max HP +25, two side effects, +30 Hype carry.

outcomes.text: You can hear colors.
Needles buys it back. He doesn't ask. You don't tell.

items.title: Crowd Favorite
items.text: The crowd is chanting an element: {element}!

outcomes.text: They chant louder. For you.

choices.label: Give them a show anyway
choices.desc: Next fight: Hype gains x2 for everyone.

outcomes.text: You promise fireworks.
A scalper sells your autograph. You get a cut.

items.title: Blister Nest
items.text: A drain is full of Blisters. Something glints at the bottom.

choices.label: Clear it
choices.desc: Fight 6 Blisters. Win: a random Prescription supplement and 30 Scrip.

outcomes.text: They start whistling.
You kick the grate shut. Muffled pops.
POP. Pop pop pop. You smell like regret and coins.

items.title: Wrong Weight Class
items.speaker: Clerk
items.text: A clerk insists you're in the wrong bracket.

choices.label: "You're too small." Accept the bump up
choices.desc: Next 2 fights: enemies HP x1.15, Scrip rewards x1.3.

outcomes.text: Welcome to the big leagues. Literally.

choices.label: "You're too big." Accept the bump down
choices.desc: Next 2 fights: enemies HP x0.85, Scrip rewards x0.8.

outcomes.text: You fight down a class. The class objects.
The clerk loses interest mid-sentence.

items.title: A Word With the Ref
items.speaker: Referee
items.text: The referee (a very tired goat) is counting Scrip.

choices.label: Slip him 50
choices.desc: Next fight, the first knockdown on you is waved off (poise refills).

outcomes.text: He winks. Goats can't wink. He does anyway.

effects.text: Next fight: first knockdown waved off

outcomes.text: The Commission thanks you for your service. He'll be back next week.
You saw nothing.

items.title: Ice Bath
items.speaker: Doc Sutura
items.text: Doc's ice bath. It is a dumpster. It has ice in it.

choices.label: Get in
choices.desc: Heal 25%, but start the next fight Soaked.

outcomes.text: Every nerve files a complaint.
Bracing.
Doc shrugs. "Your funeral. Literally, maybe."

items.title: Wall of Fame
items.speaker: Ludlow
items.text: Photos of champions. One frame is empty. Ludlow is holding a camera.

choices.label: Pose
choices.desc: Unlock a profile frame; +15 Hype carry.

outcomes.text: Flash. You blinked. It's perfect.
The frame stays empty. For now.

items.title: Pigeons
items.text: Several hundred pigeons. One has a Scrip note.

outcomes.text: Got it! The pigeon is furious.
The pigeons win. They always win.

choices.label: Feed them
choices.desc: Next Rooftop fight: the pigeons scatter on your JUICE (+10 Hype on activation).

outcomes.text: They will remember.

items.title: Glandco Audit
items.speaker: Glandco auditors
items.text: Men in matching windbreakers. "We're checking labels."

outcomes.text: "For destruction," they say. They do not destroy it.

choices.label: Hide it
choices.desc: 70% nothing, 30% they find it: lose it and 30 Scrip.

outcomes.text: They check everywhere except there.
They check there.

choices.label: "I'm clean."
choices.desc: They leave a coupon: shop 20% off next visit.

outcomes.text: A coupon. Glandco-branded. Slightly sticky.

items.title: Highway Rest Stop
items.text: A bench. A vending machine out of order. Peace.

outcomes.text: You dream of belts.
Something pops. Good pop.
'BELLOWS WAS HERE'. Of course he was.

choices.label: Shadowbox
choices.desc: Work on something new in the parking lot: learn a new move (1 of 2).

outcomes.text: A trucker honks. You take it as applause.

items.title: The Belt
items.text: A replica title belt in a pawn shop window.

choices.label: Buy it
choices.desc: Start the final boss with 100 Hype.

outcomes.text: It's plastic. It's perfect.
Soon.

items.title: Boiler Inspector
items.speaker: City inspector
items.text: A city inspector taps your belly with a wrench. "That's not up to code."

choices.label: Let him "fix" it
choices.desc: Steam Vent cooldown 7 -> 5 s (and Flare Rush 6 -> 4.5 s) this run, max HP -6.

outcomes.text: He hits it with the wrench until it sounds different.

effects.text: Steam Vent cooldown -2 s, Flare Rush -1.5 s

choices.label: Bribe
choices.desc: Stoke the Fire no longer burns you, and Flare Rush's backblast throws you 40% less far, this run.

outcomes.text: "Everything's up to code." It is not.

effects.text: No more self-burn, a tamer backblast

outcomes.text: He doesn't chase. He writes it down.

items.title: Molting Day
items.text: Your shell is coming off. It always picks the worst time.

choices.label: Molt now
choices.desc: Lose 15 HP; then poise +20 and knockback taken -10% this run.

outcomes.text: Crunch. Squelch. New you.

choices.label: Hold it in
choices.desc: Next fight, Anchor Drop has an extra charge.

outcomes.text: You clench. Everything.
It'll happen when it happens.

items.title: Fan Club
items.speaker: Six terns
items.text: Six terns in matching crests want a feather.

outcomes.text: They faint. All six.
Signed photos. Of you. By you.
They chant your name anyway.

items.title: Dead Battery
items.text: Your headlamp went out. You walked into a wall.

outcomes.text: Let there be light. And steering.

choices.label: Fight in the dark
choices.desc: Next fight is at night with the rim light off; win it for a Black Market pick.

outcomes.text: You can't see them. They can see you. Fair.

effects.text: Win in the dark: Black Market pick

items.title: Drain Backup
items.text: The cannery drain is overflowing. It's your drain.

choices.label: Clear it
choices.desc: Drain Dive cooldown 9 -> 7 s this run, -8 HP.

outcomes.text: You go in. You come out. Don't ask.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.desc: Your puddles last +1 s this run.

outcomes.text: The overflow is... inspiring.
Ludlow mops. Ludlow sighs.

items.title: Storm Warning
items.text: A thunderhead rolls over the bay. Your bulbs are humming.

choices.label: Stand in it
choices.desc: Next fight: start with +40 Hype and immune to Jolted, but -10 HP now.

outcomes.text: ZZZAP. You glow for an hour.
Under a pallet. Safe. Boring.

choices.label: Charge a battery
choices.desc: Place a battery in your next fight's arena.

outcomes.text: It's warm. It's humming. It's yours.
